text:
sophia: Heads-up 1 opened a PR to clean up the model catalog entry for glimmer7b and add an explicit migration checklist for the deprecated glimmer7b-legacy variant. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5142 :wave:

ben: Quick skim 1 looks useful. Two things I noticed: the bench CSV link for glimmer7b is 404ing, and the limits column still mixes "tokens" vs "sequence" units which confuses people.

leila: For the limits column, can we split it into two subrows: "tokens (max_tokens)" and "context (max_sequence)"? It will help readers scan for the right number.

sophia: Good call. I'll change the table to stacked cells and add a footnote explaining units.

ashok: Also, migration checklist should include a deterministic diff command and a tiny SDK check for variant limits. Suggestion: add this shell snippet to the checklist:

```bash
# deterministic diff to detect tokenization shifts
redwood eval --model glimmer7b-legacy --model glimmer7b-v2 --prompt-file small_eval.txt --temperature 0.0 --output diffs.json
```

ashok: And a quick canary recommendation: 5% for 24h then 25% for 48h.

leila: SDK snippet idea (python) to validate max_sequence before routing traffic:

```python
from redwood import CatalogClient
c = CatalogClient()
v = c.get_variant("glimmer7b-v2")
print(v["limits"]["max_sequence"], v["limits"]["concurrency"]) 
```

ben: Nice. Also we should note that quantized variants sometimes reduce max_sequence on memory-constrained hardware. Add a one-line compatibility note: "Quant variants may have reduced max_sequence; always check variant limits before pinning."

sophia: Added that line and the SDK snippet. I also swapped old `list_models()` examples to `catalog.list_variants()` in the SDK section.

perf-team-bot: artifact check failed: /bench/glimmer7b/2026-03-22/glimmer7b_throughput.csv -> NOT FOUND. Please coordinate with perf to reupload.

sophia: Reached out to perf; they re-uploaded as /bench/glimmer7b/2026-03-24/glimmer7b_throughput_v2.csv. Updated PR permalink.

docs-bot: Lint warning: table cell width exceeds 120 chars at /catalog/variants.md line 312. Recommend moving bench rig annotation to footnote.

leila: I'll shrink inline text and move the rig detail to a footnote (a100-40gb, seq=1536, dyn-batching=off). Keeps mobile readable.

ashok: For the deterministic diff tip, add one more note about using `--top_k 1` to force exact token outputs in some decoders. Small line will save people time.

sophia: Added that tiny note and a shell command example showing `--temperature 0.0 --top_k 1`.

ben: One more nit: the SDK reference had an old href to /sdk/old_cli which redirects. I'd prefer a follow-up PR to patch all old SDK hrefs rather than bloating this PR.

sophia: Agreed. I'll land this focused change first and open a separate PR for href cleanups.

perf-team-bot: Artifact link check: /bench/glimmer7b/2026-03-24/glimmer7b_throughput_v2.csv -> OK.

docs-bot: All CI checks passed except external links scan flagged a 301 redirect for /sdk/old_cli. Recommend follow-up PR.

leila: Approving once you respond to two tiny wording nits I left.

sophia: Addressed nits and force-pushed. CI green.

ben: Approved. Landing after green final check. :shipit:

sophia: Merging now. Post-merge: I'll open the follow-up PR to replace old SDK hrefs and add a tiny docs CI check that verifies benchmark permalinks resolve (prevents future 404s). Thanks all!
